mapper.select: SELECT id FROM member WHERE grade = 2 ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( grade, id, password, email, reg_date, no ) VALUES ( #{grade}, #{id}, #{password}, #{email}, SYSDATE, MEMBER_SEQ.NEXTVAL )
mapper.update: UPDATE member SET grade = 1, credential_version = credential_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND grade = 3

UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, email = 'withdrawn-' || no || '@invalid.roadscanner.local', grade = 4, credential_version = credential_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND grade = 1 AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion}

UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, email = 'withdrawn-' || no || '@invalid.roadscanner.local', grade = 4, credential_version = credential_version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND grade IN (1, 2) AND credential_version = #{credentialVersion}
UPDATE member SET password = #{password}, credential_version = credential_version + 1 WHERE email = #{email} AND grade IN (1, 2)
